parts.t: Central Lonsdale is the commercial and cultural heart of North Vancouver — a walkable neighbourhood with a thriving restaurant scene, boutique shopping, and a strong arts community. With condos, townhomes, and heritage houses available, it attracts buyers who want an urban lifestyle with a North Shore flavour.
